topics.title: Overview of AI Builder
topics.summary: With AI Builder, a Microsoft Power Platform feature, you can create and use AI models that optimize your business processes. You can either use a prebuilt model that is ready for many common business scenarios, or create a custom model that meets your needs.

topics.title: Use AI Builder models in Power Apps
topics.summary: With the use of Power Fx, the open-source low-code formulas, you can add more powerful and flexible integrations of AI models into your Power App. AI model prediction formulas can be integrated with any controls in canvas app.

topics.title: Business card prebuilt model
topics.summary: You can use the business card prebuilt model to extract information from business card images. If it detects a business card in the image, the AI model extracts information such as the person's name, job title, address, email, company, and phone numbers.

topics.title: Category classification prebuilt model
topics.summary: The prebuilt category classification model is a ready to use AI model that's configured to classify your text into categories that are useful for a specific business scenario. The first prebuilt category classification AI model is built around customer feedback uses.

topics.title: Use the category classification prebuilt model in Power Automate
topics.summary: Congratulations! You've created a flow that uses an AI Builder prebuilt category classification model. Select Save on the top right and then select Test to try out your flow.

topics.title: Contract processing prebuilt model (preview)
topics.summary: [This topic is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

topics.title: Entity extraction prebuilt model
topics.summary: The prebuilt entity extraction model recognizes specific data from text that's of interest to your business. The model identifies key elements from text, and then classifies them into predefined categories. This can help to transform unstructured data into structured data that's machine-readable.

topics.title: Use the entity extraction prebuilt model in Power Automate
topics.summary: Congratulations! You created a cloud flow that uses an entity extraction model. Select Save on the top right, and then select Test to try out your cloud flow.

topics.title: ID reader prebuilt model
topics.summary: You can use the identity document (ID) reader prebuilt model to extract information from passports and US driver licenses, social security, and green cards. The model extracts information such as the person’s first name, date of birth, or gender.

topics.title: Image description prebuilt model (preview)
topics.summary: [This topic is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

topics.title: Invoice processing prebuilt AI model
topics.summary: The invoice processing prebuilt AI model extracts key invoice data to help automate the processing of invoices. The invoice processing model is optimized to recognize common invoice elements like invoice ID, invoice date, amount due, and more.

topics.title: Key phrase extraction prebuilt model
topics.summary: The key phrase extraction prebuilt model identifies the main points in a text document. For example, given input text "The food was delicious and there was great service!", the model returns the main talking points: "food" and "great service".

topics.title: Language detection prebuilt model
topics.summary: The language detection prebuilt model identifies the predominant language of a text document. The model analyzes the text and returns the detected language and a numeric score from 0 through 1. Scores close to 1 indicate higher confidence in the result. The detected language is returned as the "script" of the language.

topics.title: Overview of prebuilt AI models
topics.summary: AI Builder prebuilt models help you add intelligence to apps and flows without having to gather data and then build, train, and publish your own models. For example, in Power Apps, you can add a component based on a prebuilt model that recognizes contact information from business cards.

topics.title: Receipt processing prebuilt model
topics.summary: Receipt processing is a prebuilt model that uses state-of-the-art optical character recognition (OCR) to detect printed and handwritten text and extract key information from receipts.

topics.title: Sentiment analysis prebuilt model
topics.summary: The sentiment analysis prebuilt model detects positive or negative sentiment in text data. You can use it to analyze social media, customer reviews, or any text data you're interested in. Sentiment analysis evaluates text input, and gives scores and labels at a sentence and document level.

topics.title: Text recognition prebuilt model
topics.summary: The text recognition prebuilt model extracts words from documents and images into machine-readable character streams. It uses state-of-the-art optical character recognition (OCR) to detect printed and handwritten text in images.

topics.title: Text translation prebuilt model
topics.summary: The text translation prebuilt model translates your text data in real time across more than 60 languages. This prebuilt model could help remove language barriers within your company. The text translation model can also detect the language of the text data you want to translate.

topics.title: Roles and security in AI Builder
topics.summary: AI Builder relies on environment security and Microsoft Dataverse security roles and privileges to grant access to AI features in Power Apps, Power Automate, and Microsoft Copilot Studio. For more information, go to Security overview.

topics.title: Use AI Builder in Teams
topics.summary: You can use Power Automate templates in Teams that solve a specific business purpose using AI Builder actions.

topics.title: Overview of the category classification custom model
topics.summary: The volume of text data is increasing exponentially for organizations. Channels such as email, documents, and social media contribute increasing amounts of text data. This data carries valuable information that—when extracted and acted on—helps you provide better products and services to your customers.

topics.title: Use sample data to do category classification
topics.summary: Get started exploring AI Builder category classification by using sample data to build and train a category classification model. The sample data uses customer feedback for a hospital. The goal is to train a model that can predict the category of newly received feedback.
